news.title: Power Transmission And HVDC Demand Will Support A Long-Term Bullish Thesis
news.body: Catalysts About KSH International KSH International manufactures copper and aluminum magnet winding wires used in power transformers, motors, compressors and other electric machines for domestic and global OEMs. What are the underlying business or industry changes driving this perspective? Structural spending on power transmission and distribution, including grid modernization, urbanization and power needs for data centers and renewable projects, supports ongoing demand for power transformers.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.00 (vs ₹3.25 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.00 (up from ₹3.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹8.22b (up 62% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹233.3m (up 26% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.8% (down from 3.6% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.

news.title: KSH International Limited Announces Step Down of Rohit Kushal Hegde from the Position of Joint Managing Director, Effective January 1, 2026
news.body: KSH International Limited announced that Mr. Rohit Kushal Hegde has stepped down from the position of Joint Managing Director and will continue as a Non-Executive and Non-Independent Director of the Company, liable to retire by rotation, effective from January 1, 2026. The Board of Directors of the Company, at the meeting held on January 5, 2026, noted the same and based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, approved the change in designation of Mr. Rohit Kushal Hegde from Joint Managing Director to a Non-Executive and Non-independent Director of the Company, effective from January 1, 2026 and shall be liable to retire by rotation.
